title: AND2ES — index table with an image strip that slides up on hover
note: A centred table (no. / client / title / category / year) in 11px with 21px rows and no rules. Hovering a row fills it with a #e6e6e6 bar, and that project's images slide up as a strip of four tiles (about 200×140, on #f7f7f7 mats) pinned to the bottom centre of the screen, swapping as you move down the list. The list stays put and only the strip changes. Worth reusing: a hover preview that never covers the list, unlike a cursor-follow image.
